# Cortex — guidance for LLMs and coding agents

> Local-first repository memory, governed continuation, recommend-only.
> Never treat Cortex as host mutation authority or consciousness.

## One-command attach

```bash
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/jacksonjp0311-gif/Cortex@main" cortex-attach .
```

External-home default (`~/.cortex`). Host tree unmodified. Ritual is interface design, not authority.

## Hard rules

1. Coherence / emergence / Resonant Frame metrics ≠ authority (use capabilities + epoch + geometry bits).
2. `observe_current_epoch` for diagnostics; never silent seal.
3. Promote needs q=(e,a,t,w)=(1,1,1,1); free multi-axis diagonals denied.
4. Multi-host: shared constitution, private body_epoch_id forever.
5. Recommend-only: no host source mutation from Cortex packets.
6. No temporal metric can move a constitutional bit. Frames are advisory only.
7. Epoch realign after version drift requires `--i-authorize-realign` — never silent seal.
8. Self-sensing residual ≠ authority; never NOMINAL when epoch/phase unbound.
9. Warm-in closes readiness milestone; epoch seal still needs --i-authorize-realign.
10. Binding Field names BINDING_GAP vs BUFFER_PENDING; commit closes frames only.
